description: This pattern occurs in Consensus/CFT protocols (Paxos, Raft, ZAB) when a node acknowledges a proposal or updates its internal logical clock (Term, Epoch, Sequence Number) without first flushing that state to stable storage.
trigger_condition: High-concurrency proposals combined with immediate node crashes (power failure simulation) after network transmission.
test_template: 1.  **Setup**: Establish a cluster of 3 nodes (Leader L, Follower F, Partitioned/Lagging P).
